scope.summary: Implement parent pages (the deduped Studio name for master pages; source product/panel names are never Studio names) as reusable page templates applied to document pages. The model MUST support: multiple parents applied to one page simultaneously (each applied parent surfaces as its own StudioLayer band in the layer graph); parent-based-on-parent inheritance (cascading changes down the chain); nested parents (one parent applied onto another); application to page ranges; and loading parents from another document. Backed by StudioPageSpread parent records; typed command + studio.layout events.
acceptance_criteria: parent pages with multiple-applied, based-on, nested, range-apply, and load-from-document; each parent a layer band
proof_targets: multi-parent layer-band + based-on cascade runtime; load-from-document test
expected_tests: live: multiple parents on one page each surface as a layer band; based-on edit cascades to children

risk_if_missed: No reusable page templates; furniture must be hand-placed per page; long-doc consistency impossible.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
